concept: Reach Thor and Medivac production quickly, move individual Thors by Medivac to create durable drop pressure, and cycle damaged pairs through a safe repair point while Marines secure the ground game.
rules: Check emergency_defence first, then thor_drop_pressure. Otherwise use opening, thor_tech, first_drop, thor_drop_pressure.
Pair one Medivac with one Thor and morph every Thor to High Impact Mode when it is created.
If a Medivac is below roughly one quarter health or a Thor below roughly two fifths health, send the pair to a safe repair point instead of forcing the drop.
Continue Marine, SCV, Supply Depot, and expansion production behind healthy Thor-Medivac cycles.

enter_when: The Factory, Armory, and Starport technology chain is incomplete.
phases.goal: Reach Thor and Medivac production with basic home defence.
guidance: Open Supply Depot, Barracks, two Refineries, Reaper, Orbital Command, Factory, early Marines, second Supply Depot, Armory, Factory Tech Lab, and Starport.
Do not spend early resources on an expansion before the first Thor and Medivac infrastructure is active.

enter_when: The Armory, Factory Tech Lab, or Starport is under construction or ready.
No Thor-Medivac pair is ready to leave.
phases.goal: Produce the first healthy drop pair and establish a fallback repair point.
guidance: Start Thor production as soon as the Factory Tech Lab and Armory allow it, and produce Medivacs from the Starport.
Keep Marines at home until the first Thor begins pressure.
Prepare a safe healing point between the enemy side and home.

enter_when: At least one Thor and one Medivac are available.
The first Thor drop has not yet established pressure.
phases.goal: Create the first safe, high-value Thor drop.
guidance: Load one Thor into one Medivac and fly toward the attack target while avoiding visible anti-air.
Unload only to threaten workers, production, or isolated units, and keep the Medivac ready to reload the Thor.

enter_when: One or more Thor-Medivac pairs are actively dropping, or additional pairs are being produced behind the first drop.
phases.goal: Sustain repeated pressure without losing expensive air and ground units.
guidance: Keep each Thor paired with a Medivac, attack exposed targets, and reposition from anti-air or superior ground forces.
Send damaged pairs to the repair point; repair Thors with SCVs before returning.
Continue Thor and Medivac production, Marine support, and expansions.

enter_when: Enemy forces threaten workers, the main base, or the Factory, Armory, and Starport chain.
phases.goal: Protect critical technology without losing healthy drop assets unnecessarily.
guidance: Use Marines and nearby Thors to defend first and redirect a drop home when its mobility prevents a larger loss.
Pause aggressive loading until the base is stable.
